name: – After § 1 – Am 7
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the political repression and humanitarian situation in Cuba
part_text: 1e. Denounces the devastating impact of US sanctions on Cuba’s access to fuel, electricity, medicines and essential goods; expresses grave concern at the worsening humanitarian situation, including prolonged blackouts of up to 20 hours per day in some areas, shortages affecting hospitals, transport, water and food supply, and the situation of more than 96 000 patients reportedly awaiting surgery due to reduced hospital capacity;
